attributes.action: Extend mandatory car park grace periods from 10 to 15 minutes
attributes.additional_details:
​We call on the UK Government to:
​Mandate a 15-minute grace period across all ANPR car parks before issuing PCNs.
​​Require operators to maintain cash or physical card payment options alongside apps, ensuring drivers without smartphones or mobile connectivity are not penalised.
​Enforce mandatory fine waivers when pay machines are broken.
​Enforce compliance with the Equality Act 2010 by requiring reasonable operational adjustments for elderly and disabled motorists.
attributes.background: ANPR cameras log vehicles upon entry, but finding spaces, reading terms, or dealing with broken pay machines takes time. A 10-minute limit is insufficient, especially for elderly and disabled drivers. Relying strictly on smartphone apps excludes motorists without smart devices or mobile signal.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Introduce a mandatory 15-minute grace period in all car parks" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/762649
